scientific_integrity: Theorem and proof are given explicitly. The verification data come from an executable pure Python exhaustive and sampled checker; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional complete-graph Cartesian products and distinctly coloured marked vertices only. An arbitrary initial colouring and higher-dimensional Hamming graphs are not covered. Finite computation corroborates but does not replace the all-size proof. Publication priority remains uncertain.
title: Two rounds of counting refinement recover every marked rook-graph orbit
